title: A pure source transfer domain decomposition method for Helmholtz equations in 3D unbounded domain
summary: We develop and analyze a three-dimensional pure source transfer domain decomposition method (PSTDDM) for the Helmholtz equation in free space. Extending the two-dimensional PSTDDM proposed by [Du and Wu, J. Sci. Comput., 83(2020),83:68], the proposed method transfers sources successively along the $x_1$, $x_2$, and $x_3$ directions, yielding layer-wise, bar-wise, and block-wise PSTDDMs. The main challenge in the convergence analysis is deriving wavenumber-explicit truncation-error estimates.
